newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico authorizes bidding on four electric plants.
newsitem.headline: Mexico authorizes bidding on four electric plants.

text.p: Mexico's Energy Ministry has authorized the Federal Electricity Commission (CFE) to open bidding for four new electrical energy centers, Energy Minister Jesus Reyes Heroles said Tuesday.
The bids are for the right to build and operate the centers under concessions normally lasting up to 50 years.
The Energy Ministry authorized the CFE to start the bidding process... in order to construct four new plants for a total of 1,450 megawatts," Reyes Heroles said during a conference.
Bids for the projects are to be submitted this year.
He said that in May the Energy Ministry published an invitation for commentaries for five generating projects with a total capacity of 1,600 megawatts.
"The fifth plant is being reconsidered by the CFE to see if it could be substituted by a better electric energy exchange with the market in the south of the United States," Reyes Heroles said.
